mapper.sql: o.uuid, o.name, COALESCE(o.profile->>'website', '') AS website, COALESCE(o.profile->>'industry', '') AS industry, o.management_version, o.created_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM users u WHERE u.organization_uuid = o.uuid AND u.deleted_at IS NULL) AS member_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM users u WHERE u.organization_uuid = o.uuid AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.role = 'admin') AS admin_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM workspaces w WHERE w.organization_uuid = o.uuid) AS workspace_count
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organizations WHERE uuid = #{organizationUUID}) AS found
SELECT FROM organizations o WHERE o.uuid = #{organizationUUID}
SELECT management_version FROM organizations WHERE uuid = #{organizationUUID} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE organizations SET name = COALESCE(#{params.Name}, name), profile = profile || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('website', CAST(#{params.Website} AS text), 'industry', CAST(#{params.Industry} AS text))), updated_at = now() WHERE uuid = #{params.OrganizationUUID}
mapper.select: SELECT uuid, email, name, role FROM users WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND uuid = #{memberUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT uuid, email, name, role FROM users WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND lower(email) = lower(#{email}) AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, email, name, role, registration_identity) VALUES (#{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.Email}, #{params.Name}, #{params.Role}, false)
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET role = #{role}, updated_at = now() WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND uuid = #{memberUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash, response FROM platform_admin_create_requests WHERE account_uuid = #{accountUUID} AND idempotency_key = #{key} AND expires_at > now()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_admin_create_requests (account_uuid, idempotency_key, request_hash, response, expires_at) VALUES (#{params.AccountUUID}, #{params.Key}, #{params.Hash}, #{params.Response}, now() + interval '24 hours') ON CONFLICT (account_uuid, idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET request_hash = EXCLUDED.request_hash, response = EXCLUDED.response, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
